before: фоника, обучение чтению по звукам букв
after: фонетический метод обучения чтению (по звукам букв)
why: false friend: Russian "фоника" is a term from poetics (the sound organization of verse), not a reading-instruction method. The gloss and all three examples define the school method of teaching reading by letter-sound correspondence, which in Russian is фонетический/звуковой метод обучения чтению. The descriptive half was kept; the misleading lead word was removed.

wrong sense in the second item: the gloss and all three examples (contact tracing, tracing the money, tracing a family line) define only the follow-back-to-source sense, while Russian "калькирование" reads first and foremost as loan-translation in linguistics — a meaning English *tracing* does not carry. Replaced with a synonym of the sense actually defined.
